scope_note: covers wasm4pm::soundness::analyze_petri_net's decision-procedure output (3-clause SoundnessReport + is_wf_net admission) only. Does NOT cover the crown-jewel theorem WfNet.sound_iff_shortCircuit_live_bounded (deferred to a future 012B — see receipt) or the short-circuit construction.

rust_input_type.type: WfNetCarrier { num_places, num_transitions, source, sink, t_pre: Vec<Vec<usize>>, t_post: Vec<Vec<usize>> } -- unweighted, set-based (StructuralNet::from_petri_net deduplicates parallel arcs via push_unique)

encoder.note: builds a real models::PetriNet, so the Rust side of the comparison exercises the actual shipped soundness::analyze_petri_net entrypoint, not a reimplementation

canonical_carrier.name: WfNetCarrier
invariants: exactly one source place (no incoming structural arcs)
exactly one sink place (no outgoing structural arcs)
every place/transition structurally on a source->sink path

decoder.note: independent, from-scratch reachability + 3-clause check, hand-transcribed from WfNet.Sound's literal definition -- does NOT call into StructuralNet internals, so the differential comparison is meaningful

canonical_result.name: WfSoundnessResult
canonical_result.representation: { no_dead_transitions, option_to_complete, proper_completion, is_sound: bool, reachable_marking_count: usize, explored_truncated: bool }

rust_output_type.type: struct, same 6 fields extracted for comparison

comparison_mode_note: NOT a live Lean invocation -- same constraint as W4PM-LEAN-GALL-010/011 (mfact .lake build directory does not exist).

lean_theorem_ref.verified_by: direct file read during W4PM-LEAN-GALL-012 (re-confirmed, not just cited from a prior round)

method_note: NOT exhaustive enumeration, unlike W4PM-LEAN-GALL-011. Full exhaustion over even a small (3-place/2-transition) unweighted-net space requires a full bounded-BFS reachability graph per candidate net (not an O(1) firing check), several orders of magnitude more expensive per item than 011's cost, and most arbitrary small arc-index-list combinations fail WF-net structural admission before soundness is even meaningful. 6 hand-constructed, individually justified fixture nets used instead.
not_claimed: direct_theorem/EXACT_CORRESPONDENCE (no live Lean re-verification); exhaustive-domain coverage (unlike 011); the crown-jewel sound_iff_shortCircuit_live_bounded theorem (deferred, needs independent liveness/boundedness checkers and the short-circuit construction -- a separate, larger harness); an infinite-transition countermodel (not constructible as a finite Rust test by definition -- only meaningful as a Lean-side existence proof about the theorem, not the decision procedure)
